source_id: BW-FTS-01 — Row 1 (Prepared/Draft file held by Sender → Active/Circulated file held by Recipient), FTS-UC-003
purpose: Verify the single send/forward transition from a Prepared/Draft file held by the Sender, with zero onward traversal.
preconditions: A Prepared/Draft file exists and is held by the Sender
Sender is an authorized Institute Employee
Recipient is a valid Institute Employee different from the Sender
File is not archived
action_or_input: Sender chooses Send/Forward on the Draft file, selects the Recipient and supplies a mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File state becomes Active/Circulated and is held by the Recipient. Movement, history and audit are updated. The required notification event(s) are triggered. No further onward-forward traversal occurs within this path.

source_id: BW-FTS-01 — Row 1 (Prepared/Draft or Active file held by Sender → Active/Circulated file held by Recipient), FTS-UC-003
purpose: Verify the same send/forward transition when the From State is an Active file held by the Sender (distinct from Draft).
preconditions: An Active file exists and is held by the Sender
Sender is authorized
Recipient is a valid Institute Employee
File is not archived
action_or_input: Sender chooses Send/Forward, selects the Recipient and supplies a mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File state is Active/Circulated and held by the Recipient. Movement, history and audit are updated. Notification event(s) are triggered.

source_id: BW-FTS-01 — Row 1 guard: 'Sender authorized'
purpose: Verify the transition does not occur when the sender is not authorized.
preconditions: A file exists in a From State of Row 1
The acting user is not authorized to send/forward the file
action_or_input: The unauthorized user attempts Send/Forward with a valid recipient and a mandatory comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and the transition to 'Active/Circulated file held by Recipient' does not occur. The file remains held by its original holder, with no movement recorded and no recipient notification triggered.

source_id: BW-FTS-01 — Row 1 guard: 'file not archived'
purpose: Verify an archived file cannot be sent/forwarded through the BW-FTS-01 transition.
preconditions: The file is in the Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained state
An otherwise authorized user attempts the send
action_or_input: The user attempts Send/Forward on the archived file with a valid recipient and a mandatory comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and no transition occurs. The file remains Archived/Read-only, with no new movement recorded.

source_id: BW-FTS-01 — Row 1 guard: 'valid Institute Employee recipient'
purpose: Verify the transition is blocked when the recipient is not a valid Institute Employee.
preconditions: Authorized Sender holds the file, not archived
The chosen recipient is not a valid Institute Employee
action_or_input: Sender attempts Send/Forward to the invalid recipient with a mandatory comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and the file is not moved to the recipient. The file remains held by the Sender, with no movement recorded and no notification triggered.

source_id: BW-FTS-01 — Row 1 guard: 'mandatory movement comment present'
purpose: Verify the transition is blocked when the mandatory movement comment is missing.
preconditions: Authorized Sender holds the file, not archived
Recipient is a valid Institute Employee
action_or_input: Sender attempts Send/Forward without supplying a movement comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and the file is not moved. The file remains held by the Sender, with no movement or history entry added and no notification triggered.

source_id: BW-FTS-02 — Row 1 (Active/Circulated file held by Current Recipient → held by Next Recipient), FTS-UC-003
purpose: Verify exactly one traversal of the onward-forward loop by the current holder.
preconditions: An Active/Circulated file is held by the Current Recipient
Current holder is authorized
Next Recipient is a valid Institute Employee
File is not archived
action_or_input: Current holder chooses to forward the received file onward, selects the Next Recipient and supplies a mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File state is Active/Circulated and held by the Next Recipient. Movement, history and audit are updated. Notification event(s) are triggered. Exactly one onward traversal is represented.

source_id: BW-FTS-02 — Row 1 guard: 'Current holder authorized'
purpose: Verify onward forwarding is blocked for an unauthorized current holder.
preconditions: An Active/Circulated file is held by a user who is not authorized to forward it
action_or_input: The user attempts to forward the file onward with a valid next recipient and a mandatory comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and no transition occurs. The file remains held by the Current Recipient, with no movement recorded.

source_id: BW-FTS-02 — Row 1 guard: 'file not archived'
purpose: Verify onward forwarding is blocked for an archived file.
preconditions: The file is Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained
action_or_input: A user attempts onward forwarding with a valid next recipient and a mandatory comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and no transition occurs. The file remains Archived/Read-only.

source_id: BW-FTS-02 — Row 1 guard: 'valid next recipient'
purpose: Verify onward forwarding is blocked when the next recipient is not valid.
preconditions: An Active/Circulated file is held by an authorized Current Holder
The chosen next recipient is not valid
action_or_input: Current holder attempts to forward onward to the invalid recipient with a mandatory comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and the file is not moved. It remains held by the Current Holder, with no movement recorded.

source_id: BW-FTS-02 — Row 1 guard: 'mandatory movement comment present'
purpose: Verify onward forwarding is blocked when the mandatory comment is missing.
preconditions: An Active/Circulated file is held by an authorized Current Holder
Next Recipient is valid
action_or_input: Current holder attempts to forward onward without a movement comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and the file is not moved. It remains held by the Current Holder, with no movement recorded.

source_id: BW-FTS-03 — Row 1 (Active/Circulated file held by Recipient; previous sender known → held by Previous Sender), FTS-UC-004
purpose: Verify the return transition to the sender of the received movement.
preconditions: An Active/Circulated file is held by the Recipient
The previous sender is known
Recipient is authorized and the file is active
action_or_input: Recipient chooses Return and supplies a mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File state is Active/Circulated and held by the Previous Sender. Return, history and audit are updated. The required return notification event is triggered.

source_id: BW-FTS-03 — Row 1 guard: 'Recipient authorized'
purpose: Verify return is blocked for an unauthorized user.
preconditions: An Active/Circulated file is held by a user who is not authorized to return it
The previous sender is known
action_or_input: The user attempts Return with a mandatory comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and no transition occurs. The file remains held by the same user, with no return recorded and no return notification triggered.

source_id: BW-FTS-03 — Row 1 guard: 'active file'
purpose: Verify return is blocked when the file is not active (Archived).
preconditions: The file is Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained
action_or_input: A user attempts Return with a mandatory comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and no transition occurs. The file remains Archived/Read-only.

source_id: BW-FTS-03 — Row 1 guard: 'mandatory movement comment present'
purpose: Verify return is blocked when the mandatory comment is missing.
preconditions: An Active/Circulated file is held by an authorized Recipient
The previous sender is known
action_or_input: Recipient attempts Return without a movement comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and the file is not returned. It remains held by the Recipient, with no return recorded.

source_id: BW-FTS-04 — Row 1 (Active/Circulated file; objective complete → Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained), FTS-UC-007
purpose: Verify the lifecycle-closing archival transition by the file owner.
preconditions: An Active/Circulated file exists
The intended collaborative objective is complete
The requester is the file owner
File is not already archived
action_or_input: File owner selects Archive.
expected_result: File state becomes Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained. Archive and audit are recorded. The archive notification event is triggered for the associated Institute Employees.

source_id: BW-FTS-04 — Row 1 guard: 'Requester is file owner'
purpose: Verify archival is blocked when the requester is not the file owner.
preconditions: An Active/Circulated file exists with objective complete
The requester is an Institute Employee who is not the file owner
action_or_input: The non-owner selects Archive.
expected_result: The guard fails and no transition occurs. The file remains Active/Circulated, with no archive/audit record and no archive notification.

source_id: BW-FTS-04 — Row 1 guard: 'file is not already archived'
purpose: Verify archival is blocked when the file is already archived.
preconditions: The file is already Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained
The requester is the file owner
action_or_input: File owner selects Archive again.
expected_result: The guard fails and no new archival transition occurs. The file remains Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained.

source_id: BW-FTS-04 — Row 1 guard: 'objective complete'
purpose: Verify archival is not performed when the intended collaborative objective is not complete.
preconditions: An Active/Circulated file exists
The requester is the file owner
The intended collaborative objective is not complete
action_or_input: File owner selects Archive.
expected_result: The guard 'objective complete' is not satisfied and the file does not reach the Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained state. No archive notification is triggered.

source_id: BW-FTS-05 — Rows 1–2 (No file record → Draft → Active/Circulated held by Recipient), FTS-UC-001, FTS-UC-003
purpose: Verify create followed directly by initial circulation with zero draft-edit traversal.
preconditions: No FTS file record exists for the intended file
Creator holds an authorized assigned role
Recipient is a valid Institute Employee
action_or_input: Creator creates a new file with an initial mandatory comment (no attachments), then sends it to the Recipient with a mandatory movement comment without any draft edit.
expected_result: After step 1 the file is Draft/Pre-circulation. After step 2 the file is Active/Circulated and held by the Recipient. Movement, history and audit are updated and notification event(s) are triggered. No edit step occurs.

source_id: BW-FTS-05 — Row 1 guard: 'initial mandatory comment present'
purpose: Verify creation is blocked when the initial mandatory comment is missing.
preconditions: No FTS file record exists
Creator holds an authorized assigned role
action_or_input: Creator attempts Create New File without an initial comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and no Draft/Pre-circulation file is created. State remains 'No FTS file record'.

source_id: BW-FTS-05 — Row 1 guard: 'Authorized assigned role'
purpose: Verify creation is blocked when the actor lacks an authorized assigned role.
preconditions: No FTS file record exists
The acting user does not hold an authorized assigned role for file creation
action_or_input: The user attempts Create New File with an initial mandatory comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and no Draft/Pre-circulation file is created. State remains 'No FTS file record'.

source_id: BW-FTS-05 — Row 2 guard: 'mandatory movement comment present'
purpose: Verify initial circulation of a Draft is blocked without a movement comment.
preconditions: A Draft/Pre-circulation file exists, held by the authorized Creator/Sender
Recipient is valid
action_or_input: Sender attempts Send without a movement comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and the file remains Draft/Pre-circulation, with no movement recorded and no notification triggered.

source_id: BW-FTS-05 — Row 2 guard: 'valid Institute Employee recipient'
purpose: Verify initial circulation of a Draft is blocked with an invalid recipient.
preconditions: A Draft/Pre-circulation file exists, held by the authorized Creator/Sender
The chosen recipient is not a valid Institute Employee
action_or_input: Sender attempts Send to the invalid recipient with a mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and the file remains Draft/Pre-circulation, with no movement recorded.

source_id: BW-FTS-06 — Rows 1–3 (Create → Edit once → Send), FTS-UC-001, FTS-UC-002, FTS-UC-003
purpose: Verify create, exactly one draft-edit traversal, and initial circulation.
preconditions: No FTS file record exists
Creator holds an authorized assigned role
Recipient is a valid Institute Employee
action_or_input: Creator creates a new file with an initial mandatory comment and an optional attachment, edits the saved draft once and saves, then sends it to the Recipient with a mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: After step 1 the file is Draft/Pre-circulation. After the edit it is Updated Draft/Pre-circulation. After send it is Active/Circulated and held by the Recipient. Movement, history and audit are updated and notification event(s) are triggered.

source_id: BW-FTS-06 — Row 2 guard: 'Actor authorized'
purpose: Verify the draft edit is blocked for an unauthorized actor.
preconditions: A Draft/Pre-circulation file exists
The acting user is not authorized to edit the draft
action_or_input: The user attempts to edit and save the draft.
expected_result: The guard fails and the file remains Draft/Pre-circulation, not Updated Draft. No edit is saved.

source_id: BW-FTS-06 — Row 2 guard: 'file remains pre-circulation'
purpose: Verify the draft edit transition is not available once the file has been circulated.
preconditions: The file is Active/Circulated (already submitted)
An authorized user attempts the Edit outcome of FTS-UC-002
action_or_input: The user attempts to edit the circulated file through the draft-edit transition.
expected_result: The guard fails and no transition to 'Updated Draft / Pre-circulation file' occurs. The file remains Active/Circulated.

source_id: BW-FTS-06 — Row 3 guard: 'mandatory movement comment present'
purpose: Verify sending an Updated Draft is blocked without a movement comment.
preconditions: An Updated Draft/Pre-circulation file exists, held by the authorized Sender
Recipient is valid
action_or_input: Sender attempts Send without a movement comment.
expected_result: The guard fails and the file remains Updated Draft/Pre-circulation, with no movement recorded.

source_id: BW-FTS-07 — Rows 1–2 (Create → Discard), FTS-UC-001, FTS-UC-002 Discard outcome
purpose: Verify create followed by discard with zero draft-edit traversal.
preconditions: No FTS file record exists
Creator holds an authorized assigned role
action_or_input: Creator creates a new file with an initial mandatory comment, then chooses Discard before submission without editing.
expected_result: After step 1 the file is Draft/Pre-circulation. After Discard the state is Discarded/No active file retained. No edit step occurs.

source_id: BW-FTS-07 — Row 2 guard: 'file has not been submitted/circulated'
purpose: Verify Discard is blocked for a file already submitted/circulated.
preconditions: The file is Active/Circulated
An authorized user attempts the Discard outcome
action_or_input: The user chooses Discard on the circulated file.
expected_result: The guard fails and the file is not moved to Discarded/No active file retained. It remains Active/Circulated.

source_id: BW-FTS-07 — Row 2 guard: 'Actor authorized'
purpose: Verify Discard is blocked for an unauthorized actor.
preconditions: A Draft/Pre-circulation file exists
The acting user is not authorized
action_or_input: The user chooses Discard on the draft.
expected_result: The guard fails and the file remains Draft/Pre-circulation, not Discarded.

source_id: BW-FTS-07 — Row 1 guard: 'initial mandatory comment present'
purpose: Verify the Create step of the discard workflow is blocked without an initial comment, so Discard is not reached.
preconditions: No FTS file record exists
Creator holds an authorized assigned role
action_or_input: Creator attempts Create New File without an initial comment.
expected_result: No Draft/Pre-circulation file is created and the Discard transition is unavailable. State remains 'No FTS file record'.

source_id: BW-FTS-08 — Rows 1–3 (Create → Edit once → Discard), FTS-UC-001, FTS-UC-002
purpose: Verify create, exactly one draft-edit traversal, then discard before circulation.
preconditions: No FTS file record exists
Creator holds an authorized assigned role
action_or_input: Creator creates a new file with an initial mandatory comment, edits the draft once and saves, then chooses Discard before submission.
expected_result: After step 1 the file is Draft/Pre-circulation. After the edit it is Updated Draft/Pre-circulation. After Discard the state is Discarded/No active file retained.

source_id: BW-FTS-08 — Row 3 guard: 'Actor authorized'
purpose: Verify Discard of an Updated Draft is blocked for an unauthorized actor.
preconditions: An Updated Draft/Pre-circulation file exists
The acting user is not authorized
action_or_input: The user chooses Discard.
expected_result: The guard fails and the file remains Updated Draft/Pre-circulation, not Discarded.

source_id: BW-FTS-08 — Row 2 guard: 'Actor authorized; file remains pre-circulation; edits are saved'
purpose: Verify the edit step is blocked for an unauthorized actor within the edit-then-discard path, so the Updated Draft state is not reached.
preconditions: A Draft/Pre-circulation file exists
The acting user is not authorized to edit
action_or_input: The user attempts to edit and save the draft.
expected_result: The guard fails and no Updated Draft state is produced. The file remains Draft/Pre-circulation.

source_id: CW-FTS-01 — Rows 1 and 5 (BW-FTS-01 then BW-FTS-04; zero onward traversal skips Row 2)
purpose: Verify the composite path: send, zero onward traversal, then owner archival.
preconditions: A valid Prepared/Draft or Active file is held by the Sender
Recipient is valid
The intended collaborative objective will be complete
The file owner is identified
action_or_input: Sender sends the file with a mandatory comment; the Recipient takes no onward or return action; the File Owner then selects Archive.
expected_result: After send the file is Active/Circulated and held by the Recipient. After archival the file is Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained. Movement, history and audit are updated, and send and archive notification events are triggered. The onward-forward row is not traversed.

source_id: CW-FTS-01 — Rows 1, 2 and 5 (BW-FTS-01, BW-FTS-02, BW-FTS-04; one onward traversal)
purpose: Verify the composite path with exactly one onward-forward traversal followed by owner archival.
preconditions: A valid file is held by the Sender
Recipient and Next Recipient are valid
The File Owner is identified
action_or_input: Sender sends to the Recipient with a comment; the Recipient forwards onward to the Next Recipient with a comment; the File Owner archives after the objective is complete.
expected_result: After send the file is held by the Recipient. After onward forward it is Active/Circulated and held by the Next Recipient. After archival it is Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained. Movement, history and audit are updated at each step and notifications are triggered.

source_id: CW-FTS-01 — Rows 1 and 3 (BW-FTS-01 then BW-FTS-03; Alternative return branch)
purpose: Verify the composite path: send then immediate return to the previous sender.
preconditions: A valid file is held by the Sender
Recipient is valid
action_or_input: Sender sends to the Recipient with a comment; the Recipient returns the file with a mandatory comment.
expected_result: After send the file is held by the Recipient. After return it is Active/Circulated and held by the Previous Sender. Return, history and audit are updated and the return notification event is triggered.

source_id: CW-FTS-01 — Rows 1, 2 and 4 (return after one onward traversal)
purpose: Verify the next recipient returns the file to the sender of the onward movement after one onward traversal.
preconditions: A valid file is held by the Sender
Recipient and Next Recipient are valid
action_or_input: Sender sends to the Recipient; the Recipient forwards onward to the Next Recipient; the Next Recipient returns the file with a mandatory comment.
expected_result: After the onward forward the file is held by the Next Recipient. After return it is Active/Circulated and held by the Prior Sender of that movement (the Recipient who forwarded onward), not the original Sender. Return, history and audit are updated and the return notification event is triggered.

source_id: CW-FTS-01 — Rows 1, 3 and 5 (archival from an Active/Circulated state after return)
purpose: Verify owner archival from the Active/Circulated state reached after a return.
preconditions: A file has been sent and then returned, and is Active/Circulated and held by the Previous Sender
The intended collaborative objective is complete
The requester is the File Owner
action_or_input: File Owner selects Archive.
expected_result: File state becomes Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained. Archive and audit are recorded and the archive notification event is triggered.

source_id: CW-FTS-01 — Rows 1, 2, 4 and 5 (archival after return following one onward traversal)
purpose: Verify archival closes the lifecycle after the full onward-then-return sequence.
preconditions: A file has been sent, forwarded onward once, and returned by the Next Recipient
The file is Active/Circulated, held by the Prior Sender of the onward movement
The objective is complete and the requester is the File Owner
action_or_input: File Owner selects Archive.
expected_result: File state becomes Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained, with archive and audit recorded and the archive notification event triggered.

source_id: CW-FTS-01 — Row 5 (Archived/Read-only terminal state); BW-FTS-01 Row 1 guard 'file not archived'
purpose: Verify an archived file cannot continue through the circulation transitions of the composite workflow.
preconditions: The file has reached Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained through CW-FTS-01 Row 5
action_or_input: A user attempts to send/forward the archived file with a valid recipient and a mandatory comment.
expected_result: The transition does not occur and the file remains Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained.

source_id: CW-FTS-01 — Row 5 guard (owner archives; objective complete); BW-FTS-04 Row 1
purpose: Verify the cross-cutting archival transition is blocked for a non-owner during an active composite circulation.
preconditions: A file is Active/Circulated, held by the Recipient or Next Recipient
The requester is not the File Owner
action_or_input: The non-owner selects Archive.
expected_result: The transition to Archived/Read-only/Permanently retained does not occur and the file remains Active/Circulated.

source_id: CW-FTS-02 — Rows 1 and 5 (BW-FTS-05; zero edit traversal, initial circulation)
purpose: Verify the composite path: create then send with zero draft-edit traversal.
preconditions: No FTS file record exists
Creator holds an authorized assigned role
Recipient is valid
action_or_input: Creator creates a new file with an initial mandatory comment, then sends it to the Recipient with a mandatory movement comment, skipping the edit row.
expected_result: The file moves No record → Draft/Pre-circulation → Active/Circulated held by the Recipient. Movement, history and audit are updated and notification event(s) are triggered.

source_id: CW-FTS-02 — Rows 1, 2 and 6 (BW-FTS-06; one edit traversal, initial circulation)
purpose: Verify the composite path: create, one draft edit, then send.
preconditions: No FTS file record exists
Creator holds an authorized assigned role
Recipient is valid
action_or_input: Creator creates a new file with an initial mandatory comment, edits the draft once, then sends it to the Recipient with a mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: The file moves No record → Draft → Updated Draft → Active/Circulated held by the Recipient. Movement, history and audit are updated and notification event(s) are triggered.

source_id: CW-FTS-02 — Rows 1 and 3 (BW-FTS-07; discard with zero edit traversal)
purpose: Verify the composite alternative terminal outcome: create then discard.
preconditions: No FTS file record exists
Creator holds an authorized assigned role
action_or_input: Creator creates a new file with an initial mandatory comment, then chooses Discard before submission.
expected_result: The file moves No record → Draft/Pre-circulation → Discarded/No active file retained.

source_id: CW-FTS-02 — Rows 1, 2 and 4 (BW-FTS-08; discard after exactly one edit traversal)
purpose: Verify the composite terminal outcome: create, one edit, then discard.
preconditions: No FTS file record exists
Creator holds an authorized assigned role
action_or_input: Creator creates a new file with an initial mandatory comment, edits the draft once, then chooses Discard before submission.
expected_result: The file moves No record → Draft → Updated Draft → Discarded/No active file retained.

source_id: CW-FTS-02 — Rows 3 and 4 guard: 'Discard before circulation'; BW-FTS-07 Row 2 guard
purpose: Verify that once a new file has reached initial circulation (Active/Circulated), the discard outcome of CW-FTS-02 is no longer available.
preconditions: A file created through CW-FTS-02 has been sent and is Active/Circulated held by the Recipient
action_or_input: The Creator attempts to choose Discard on the circulated file.
expected_result: The guard (file has not been submitted/circulated) fails and the file is not moved to Discarded/No active file retained. It remains Active/Circulated.
